desc.cn: 达成<@ba.key>组合</>的敌人对生命值高于<@ba.key>50%</>的干员造成伤害时，根据该敌人的战力点施加<@ba.key>1</>层特定属性的<@ba.key>法术附着</>。
desc.en: When an enemy forming the <@ba.key>hand</> deals DMG to operators with <@ba.key>＞ 50%</> HP, refer to the enemy's BP and apply <@ba.key>1</> stack of <@ba.key>Arts Infliction</> of the specified element.

desc.cn: 达成<@ba.key>好运组合</>的敌人对生命值高于<@ba.key>50%</>的干员造成伤害时，根据该敌人的战力点施加<@ba.key>1</>种特定属性的<@ba.key>法术异常</>。
desc.en: When an enemy forming the <@ba.key>Lucky Hand</> deals DMG to operators with <@ba.key>＞ 50%</> HP, refer to the enemy's BP and apply <@ba.key>1</> stack of <@ba.key>Arts Reaction</> of the specified element.

desc.cn: 战斗开始后，所有敌人基于入战干员的属性，对应的属性抗性<@ba.key>+15</>。
desc.en: At the start of battle, refer to the elements of operators entering the fight, and grant all enemies Resistance <@ba.key>+15</> against the said elements.

desc.cn: 战斗开始后，所有敌人基于入战干员的属性，对应的属性抗性<@ba.key>+20</>。
desc.en: At the start of battle, refer to the elements of operators entering the fight, and grant all enemies Resistance <@ba.key>+20</> against the said elements.

desc.cn: 达成<@ba.key>组合</>的敌人对生命值高于<@ba.key>50%</>的干员造成伤害时，根据该敌人的战力点施加<@ba.key>2</>层特定属性的<@ba.key>法术附着</>。
desc.en: When an enemy forming the <@ba.key>hand</> deals DMG to operators with <@ba.key>＞ 50%</> HP, refer to the enemy's BP and apply <@ba.key>2</> stacks of <@ba.key>Arts Infliction</> of the specified element.

desc.cn: 达成<@ba.key>好运组合</>的敌人对生命值高于<@ba.key>50%</>的干员造成伤害时，根据该敌人的战力点施加<@ba.key>1</>种特定属性的<@ba.key>法术异常</>。
desc.en: When an enemy forming the <@ba.key>Lucky Hand</> deals DMG to operators with <@ba.key>＞ 50%</> HP, refer to the enemy's BP and apply <@ba.key>1</> stack of <@ba.key>Arts Reaction</> of the specified element.

desc.cn: 达成<@ba.key>组合</>的敌人获得<@ba.key>3</>层<@ba.key>层叠护盾</>。
达成<@ba.key>好运组合</>的敌人获得<@ba.key>3</>层<@ba.key>层叠护盾</>，攻击力、最大生命值、移动速度提高<@ba.key>33%</>。
desc.en: Enemies forming the <@ba.key>Lucky Hand</> gain <@ba.key>3</> <@ba.key>shield stacks</>. They also gain a <@ba.key>33%</> boost to ATK, Max HP, and Movement Speed.

desc.cn: 敌人被击败后，根据该敌人的战力点永久提高其他所有敌人的攻击力与最大生命值。
desc.en: When an enemy is defeated, all other enemies gain a permanent boost to ATK and Max HP (based on the BP of the defeated enemy).

desc.cn: 敌人被击败后，根据该敌人的战力点永久提高其他所有敌人的攻击力与最大生命值，然后回复一定生命值。
desc.en: When an enemy is defeated, all other enemies gain a permanent boost to ATK and Max HP (based on the BP of the defeated enemy), and receive some HP restoration.

desc.cn: 战斗开始后，战力点最高的<@ba.key>1</>名敌人成为<@ba.key>魁首</>。<@ba.key>魁首</>抗打断能力、攻击力、最大生命值大幅提高，除<@ba.key>魁首</>外所有敌人造成伤害时会给<@ba.key>魁首</>回复一定生命值。
desc.en: At the start of battle, <@ba.key>1</> enemy with the highest BP will become a <@ba.key>Chief</>. The <@ba.key>Chief</> gains a large boost to Interruption Resistance, ATK, and Max HP. Whenever <@ba.key>non-Chief enemies</> deal DMG, the <@ba.key>Chief</> also receives some HP restoration.

desc.cn: 战斗开始后，战力点最高的<@ba.key>2</>名敌人成为<@ba.key>魁首</>。<@ba.key>魁首</>抗打断能力、攻击力、最大生命值大幅提高，除<@ba.key>魁首</>外所有敌人造成伤害时会给<@ba.key>魁首</>回复一定生命值。
desc.en: At the start of battle, <@ba.key>2</> enemies with the highest BP will become <@ba.key>Chiefs</>. <@ba.key>Chiefs</> gain a large boost to Interruption Resistance, ATK, and Max HP. Whenever <@ba.key>non-Chief enemies</> deal DMG, the <@ba.key>Chiefs</> also receive some HP restoration.

desc.cn: 所有敌人被击败后，1名头目敌人加入演算。
desc.en: When all enemies are defeated, 1 special alpha-tier enemy will join the trial.

desc.cn: 所有敌人被击败后，1名头目敌人加入演算。敌人被击败后，根据该敌人的战力点永久提高其他所有敌人的攻击力与最大生命值，头目敌人会继承所有增益效果。
desc.en: When all enemies are defeated, 1 special alpha-tier enemy will join the trial. When an enemy is defeated, all other enemies gain a permanent boost to ATK and Max HP (based on the BP of the defeated enemy). The alpha-tier enemy will receive every boost.

desc.cn: 所有敌人被击败后，1名头目敌人加入演算，该敌人攻击力与最大生命值大幅提高。
desc.en: When all enemies are defeated, 1 special alpha-tier enemy will join the trial. This enemy has a large boost to its ATK and Max HP.
